product.title: Mount Blue Sky, Clear Creek Canyon & Red Rocks Park (Mount Evans)

description.text: Escape Denver and immerse yourself in the nature of Mt. Blue Sky (formerly Mt. Evans) and the Rocky Mountains during this small-group day trip. Reach the summit via tour vehicle, get out to explore, and get epic views over the surrounding Rockies. Stops include Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre, Echo Lake, Mount Blue Sky, Clear Creek Canyon, Idaho Springs. Along the way, stop at Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre, Clear Creek Canyon, Idaho Springs, Summit Lake, and Echo Lake. Ideal for visitors basing in Denver who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating transport, trailheads, or mountain logistics on their own.
